notes.title: Celebratory T-Shirt Set Available Now for Free!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44638367/00c1feed9fb8ab9f0a8322d29c9c233b107a2729.png[/img]

To commemorate one million copies of Like a Dragon: Infinite Wealth sold within one week of its launch, owners of the game can now enjoy an in-game Celebratory T-Shirt Set for free, automatically acquirable after applying patch 1.18.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44638367/14af1980ad6cdccd4e92b2dfa03838da2836f27d.png[/img]

The Celebratory T-Shirt Set is wearable by each party member, and can be accessed at the outfit selection in the Alo-Happy room. The set includes the following 11 unique t-shirts:
[list]
[*]Special Outfit: Go for Victory Shirt
[*]Special Outfit: Legendary Dragon Shirt
[*]Special Outfit: Hero of Yokohama Shirt
[*]Special Outfit: Pixel Shirt
[*]Special Outfit: White Matsumoto Shave Ice Shirt
[*]Special Outfit: Team Kasuga Pixel Shirt
[*]Special Outfit: Team Kiryu Pixel Shirt
[*]Special Outfit: Gaiden TGS Shirt
[*]Special Outfit: Infinite Wealth TGS Shirt
[*]Special Outfit: 88Tees Shirt
[*]Special Outfit: Lawson Exclusive Shirt
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44638367/991338eb1e20625f3268002b23203a8722b33d2f.jpg[/img]

Want to wear one yourself and match with the party? Check out some of the t-shirts available for purchase and international shipping on the [url=https://ebten.jp/search?name=%E9%BE%8D%E3%81%8C%E5%A6%82%E3%81%8F]SEGA STORE[/url]! 

[h1]STEAM DECK VERIFIED[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44638367/73bfbdc96dd39cfcfee622a0329b2efe745ffc8e.png[/img]

Two larger-than-life heroes, Ichiban Kasuga and Kazuma Kiryu are brought together by the hand of fate, or perhaps something more sinister… Live it up in Japan and explore all that Hawaii has to offer in an RPG adventure so big it spans the Pacific.

notes.title: Check Out the New Jobs in Infinite Wealth
notes.content:
[h1]LINEBACKER AND TENNIS ACE[/h1]
[previewyoutube=qve36DJEuAA;full][/previewyoutube]

Check out the Linebacker and Tennis Ace jobs in this new trailer. 

Hut! Hut! HIKE! Enemies will never be able to catch what's coming against Linebacker. Handoff some devastating blows with skills like Quarterback Sack, or go for the touchdown and finish a battle with Essence of Endzone.

Tennis Ace uses moves straight from the court to attack enemies. Lob over some skills like Wicked Wall Drills and Rapid-Fire Rally, or serve up a fierce Essence move like Essence of Hurricane Smash to deliver some serious damage.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2072450/Like_a_Dragon_Infinite_Wealth]Pre-order before it's too late[/url] and get the Hero’s Booster Pack and Special Job Set to increase your party members' level and job rank and receive the new Tennis Ace and Linebacker jobs.


[h1]AQUANAUT[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44638367/fd6ca43f9bcf67edc29be59b38c49360b02531e9.png[/img]

Aquanaut utilizes marine creatures and marine-themed items to confuse opponents. The job boasts an array of unique techniques inspired by the sea, allowing the user to blind enemies with squid ink or paralyze them with electric jellyfish. Aquanaut is capable of both offensive and healing, making it extremely user-friendly!


[h1]GEODANCER[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44638367/2b33a93c72b56befbf8763ffbe81626aa017991c.png[/img]

Geodancer uses mysterious dances to attack enemies and provide support and healing to allies. The job possesses extremely high magic and is capable of unleashing powerful elemental techniques.


[h1]SUJIMANCER[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44638367/aed9f1f4e63dd7e560394379791227c1ab28ae89.png[/img]

Sujimancer harnesses the power of trained Sujimon to fight, allowing Kasuga to summon various Sujimon and giving him a range of different options in combat. The job is unique in that it grows stonger for every Sujimon you train and nurture.


[h1]SAMURAI[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44638367/984c3087feecb7e4c207cd29404f38c927608081.png[/img]

Samurai specializes in consecutive attacks and area-of-effect attacks using swords and bows, offering a range of options to deal with different foes. Use sword techniques to cause enemies to bleed and increase the amount of damage dealt, or bows to attack multiple enemies.


[h1]KUNOICHI[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44638367/fa4b2444d81d884bc0549514b192501567e0bb4b.png[/img]

Kunoichi bewilders enemies with astonishing speed and ninjutsu techniques. The job uses quick agility to trick enemies and ninjutsu to completely alter the course of battle. Don't forget to use Substitution Jutsu to swap turns with allies and use clones to deal tremendous damage! 


[h1]DESPERADO[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44638367/3bb4c9c6fe817834b5f5c1ad91834376570b87d0.png[/img]

Desperado uses dual pistols, dynamite, rope, and excels in taking out multiple enemies. The job can learn various status ailment techniques and has the ability to take down any target.


[h1]HOUSEKEEPER[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44638367/a54ab97de3d9a24625dfef21de2b05c2f08c07cd.png[/img]

Housekeeper utilizes cleaning techniques to elegantly sweep away enemies. The job specializes in multi-target combat, using mops, vacuum cleaners, and other tools of the trade to attack enemies over a wide area.

Explore all that Japan and Hawaii have to offer in an adventure so big it spans the Pacific on January 26, 2024.

notes.title: Experience One-of-a-Kind RPG Battles
notes.content:
[h1]JOB SYSTEM[/h1]
Adapt your party's skills to the situation with 18 jobs like Hero, Assassin, Desperado, Cabbie, and Samurai to change fighting styles and gain new abilities to strategically subdue enemies with unique moves. Create your ideal party by experimenting with different job combinations.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44638367/04763e28568539b01bfea0c5a75c4583f3839000.png[/img]


[h1]DYNAMIC MOVEMENT[/h1]
Utilize movement to target an enemy's weakness and weaponize the environment to give your party a strategic edge! Close the distance with enemies to deal massive damage or move next to allies to execute combo attacks! Position your characters near bicycles, cones, or other objects to use them as weapons and destroy opponents.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44638367/38e944f8257cc1a709fe95f2261059844f339ee4.png[/img]


[h1]AREA-OF-EFFECT ATTACKS[/h1]
Obliterate enemies in a straight line or in your vicinity using area-of-effect attacks! Target clusters of enemies to maximize damage, and keep a watchful eye on their positions to aim for a decisive blow to take them all down at once.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44638367/0324475ffcec04e02fae1ed170db7e2d458096b8.png[/img]


[h1]KNOCKBACK ATTACKS[/h1]
Carefully assess the positions of your enemies and their surroundings to effectively use knockback attacks! Slam them into walls, objects, or even each other to deal additional damage. Deliver even greater pain or inflict status ailments by bashing them into burning objects or explosive gas canisters.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44638367/e8666865ff6a59cde2af80e546318b643d2420d4.png[/img]


[h1]COMBO ATTACKS[/h1]
During battle, when you move within range of an ally with whom you have a strong connection, you will be able to execute powerful combo attacks. Cooperation between your allies is key to defeating formidable enemies, so actively work on deepening your bonds with them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44638367/6f2e0238b5e84e20bfdc870e83c29622200a7511.png[/img]


[h1]PERFECT ATTACKS[/h1]
Use Perfect Attacks to quickly demolish your enemies. When executing a special attack, press the correct button to perform a Perfect Attack to dish out extra blows or change the direction of your attack to damage multiple enemies.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44638367/1805162db8c0daf0cc9b1221a93e4664d0a148ed.png[/img]


[h1]SMACKDOWN[/h1]
When you encounter opponents far weaker than yourself, the Smackdown option will appear. Choosing it will let you promptly end the battle at the cost of less experience, but you may earn money or acquire items quicker.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44638367/39e7cc4ee64cce7e39f9971482c3c296743cdb9d.png[/img]


[h1]POUNDMATES[/h1]
Call up quirky characters with powerful attacks and healing skills to gain the upper hand in battle. Some will assist you by delivering a single devastating attack, while others will join the battle for a few turns. You'll be able to call on more characters as you progress through substories and other objectives, so get out there!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44638367/d5ef46d7018531af2a715ffb5d4cbe7abbaa2340.png[/img]


[h1]WEAPON CRAFTING[/h1]
Use weapons and materials to strengthen your weapons or create over 140 new ones. The weapons you create will be much stronger than the ones you find at shops, so try crafting your own! They can also be strengthened to greatly increase performance or branded to apply unique effects.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44638367/dacc55b53bbf4e579f299cb0582fd3beb0fcd257.png[/img]


[h1]PRE-ORDER LIKE A DRAGON: INFINITE WEALTH NOW[/h1]

Explore all that Japan and Hawaii have to offer in an adventure so big it spans the Pacific on January 26, 2024.[b] Pre-order now and get the Hero’s Booster Pack and Special Job Set [/b]to increase your party members' level and job rank and  receive the new Tennis Ace and Linebacker jobs.

notes.title: Collect, Train, and Battle Sujimon
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44638367/03d6edf06f0179c8b3f84c19c7ba42b7434c3965.jpg[/img]

[h1]SNAG SOME SUJIMON[/h1]

After you've finished a battle on the streets of Hawaii, you may get the opportunity to recruit a Sujimon.
You'll successfully recruit them if you sincerely offer a Suji Gift and they accept it, so take advantage of every opportunity to recruit allies!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44638367/648aea856eaafe2c16ef51a1326cf476e0b68a18.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44638367/91f1fa318d444d0939635ce6f51b5bea9d2d28e3.png[/img]


There are also raids, where those confident in their strength gather to fight. Defeating a Sujimon in a raid means you're guaranteed a chance to recruit them! Raids will vanish after a while, so try your best not to miss out on them.

One more method is to try your luck at the Sujimon Gacha spots existing around Hawaii, where you can use cash or gacha tickets to get Sujimon.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44638367/5a5f69f368491f117391678fca02d8388316c1ff.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44638367/f7bc68954b46ebbda042fde787b953b412ccc5f3.png[/img]


[h1]BATTLE IT OUT[/h1]
[b][h2]Sujimon battles are 3-vs-3 head-on competitions! [/h2][/b]
As a trainer, Kasuga gives commands to his Sujimon to try and defeat the opposing team.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44638367/a599642aa16531a2cb7529331d5f1c707731de02.png[/img]


Sujimon have five different types, each with different affinities. Find a team strategy that suits you, whether that be balancing your team, trying out a highly specialized one, or anything in between.
Boost ally morale with strategic commands and unleash their special attacks to bring victory within reach!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44638367/8347f5bd71d9358b1c6f756fcf68f9c592f27526.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44638367/84b2adf576e664b279855ed5d7a29277503eba44.png[/img]


[h2]Meet two of the many Sujimon you’ll encounter![/h2]

The Freakalele soothes his allies with the timbre of his beloved ukulele, and occasionally wields it as a blunt instrument. A healer Sujimon who spends his winnings on ukulele repairs.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44638367/85e913b5b9580ce95e2eaebb2f63164698646895.png[/img]


The Dosukoi Gigantes is a super-heavyweight fighter whose physique not unlike an iron wall gives off an air of dignity to any who behold him.

Despite his appearance, his movements are sharp, with a powerful spinning kick serving as his special attack.


[h1]TRAIN AND EVOLVE[/h1]
[h2]The Sujimon that join your team can be trained through strengthening, awakening, and evolution.[/h2]

To strengthen your Sujimon, give them some Sujimunch, a nutritional drink uniquely designed for Sujimon.

Awakening occurs when you feed a Sujimon another of their same species, which unlocks their potential and enhances their parameters. When you repeatedly awaken the same Sujimon and push them to the limit of their potential, they just might evolve!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44638367/6ca3cd8992dbb9f159b7b2288a6b82717886338d.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44638367/5e4a660929dc02cdba5ba3e9a01dfe8220073241.png[/img]


[h1]UNLOCK THE SUJIMANCER JOB[/h1]

As you progress through the Sujimon battle storyline, a new job, Sujimancer, will be unlocked.  Once you become a Sujimancer, you'll be able to equip your Sujimon and summon them into actual combat.

The stronger your Sujimon are, the more powerful your Sujimancer skills will be.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44638367/c50e2d069ad7a3109ec521b4ab1e474eec4e6588.jpg[/img]
 

[h1]PRE-ORDER LIKE A DRAGON: INFINITE WEALTH NOW[/h1]

Explore all that Japan and Hawaii have to offer in an adventure so big it spans the Pacific on January 26, 2024. Pre-order now and receive the Hero’s Booster Pack and Special Job Set.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2072450/Like_a_Dragon_Infinite_Wealth/

tags.feature: As a trainer, Kasuga gives commands to his Sujimon to try and defeat the opposing team.

Sujimon have five different types, each with different affinities. Find a team strategy that suits you, whether that be balancing your team, trying out a highly specialized one, or anything in between.
Boost ally morale with strategic commands and unleash their special attacks to bring victory within reach!
The Freakalele soothes his allies with the timbre of his beloved ukulele, and occasionally wields it as a blunt instrument. A healer Sujimon who spends his winnings on ukulele repairs.
The Dosukoi Gigantes is a super-heavyweight fighter whose physique not unlike an iron wall gives off an air of dignity to any who behold him.
Despite his appearance, his movements are sharp, with a powerful spinning kick serving as his special attack.
To strengthen your Sujimon, give them some Sujimunch, a nutritional drink uniquely designed for Sujimon.

Awakening occurs when you feed a Sujimon another of their same species, which unlocks their potential and enhances their parameters. When you repeatedly awaken the same Sujimon and push them to the limit of their potential, they just might evolve!
As you progress through the Sujimon battle storyline, a new job, Sujimancer, will be unlocked. Once you become a Sujimancer, you'll be able to equip your Sujimon and summon them into actual combat.
The stronger your Sujimon are, the more powerful your Sujimancer skills will be.
